description: Dept. of Elections - Appointed Mr. Deegoda Gamage Yasarathna as Mayor of the Matara Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Mayor in the Matara Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a local government position, including the resignation of the former mayor, the nomination by a political party, and the official declaration of a new mayor by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations for local authorities.
